facts.text: The party owes Warwick the smith metal brought back from the Dwarven mine to the north. This is their side of the bargain for which Warwick lent the mithril shirt and keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use every night while they are gone.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, which Ingrid says was his grandfather's armor. Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral until then.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
The Dwarven mine's entrance is sealed by a natural-looking cave-in, which blocks getting metal for Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has partly broken into it, uncovering a dead dwarf.
Warwick believes the Dwarven mine holds metal and is worked by seven dwarves, but the dwarves' cabin is burnt and the mine caved in. Is there still metal to be had there?
